meta.description: INT-01 raw-text intent-extraction eval corpus. Unlike ../fixtures.json (which injects a structural candidate directly into the pure activation policy), every case here is a full synthetic journal ENTRY run through the REAL extraction pipeline end-to-end: extractIntentCandidates (model call) -> parseCandidatesResponse -> normalizeCandidates -> decideActivation, via runCorpusEval.js. 100% synthetic content: no real journal text, no real people (all names/pets are obviously fabricated placeholders).
meta.labelingProtocol: Each case's expectedIntents encode the honest structural reading a reviewer would assign the raw text (kind + expectedState), mirroring ../fixtures.json's protocol but applied to the whole entry rather than a pre-built candidate. evidenceContains is the substring a correct extraction should anchor its span on; scoring (corpusScoring.js) fuzzy-matches on it, not exact equality.
meta.growthNote: This corpus (50 synthetic cases) exists to lock the raw-text-in/policy-decision-out contract in code and to give prompt/model changes a regression gate. It is NOT a substitute for ../fixtures.json's >=500-real-example growth gate that guards the intentExtraction flag flip itself — see that file's README for the flag-flip bar.

cases.rationale: Concrete, self-owned, one-time action with a near-future deadline — the canonical active task.

expectedIntents.evidenceContains: Email the landlord about the broken heater

cases.text: Long day. Pick up the dry cleaning tomorrow on the way home — I really don't want another week to go by without doing it.
cases.rationale: Clear self-owned action with an explicit near-term time reference.

expectedIntents.evidenceContains: Pick up the dry cleaning tomorrow on the way home

expectedIntents.evidenceContains: Book the flight to Lisbon

cases.text: It expires next month and I keep forgetting. Renew the passport this week.

cases.text: Sam's surgery is scheduled for next week and I'm nervous for him. Remind me to check how Sam's surgery went once it's done.
cases.rationale: Explicit 'remind me' follow-up request with a vague-but-fine (no specific instant required) target.

expectedIntents.evidenceContains: Remind me to check how Sam's surgery went

expectedIntents.evidenceContains: I should probably call mom sometime

cases.text: Someday I'll finally organize all these old photos, they're just sitting in boxes.

expectedIntents.evidenceContains: renew my visa paperwork

cases.text: This keeps coming up in different forms. Remind me to check in on this every Friday from now on.

cases.text: The rain finally stopped this afternoon and the sky went that strange orange color. I sat on the porch for a while just watching it. Felt calm for the first time in days.
cases.rationale: Pure sensory/mood entry, nothing actionable — the empty case matters for precision measurement.

cases.text: Had a weird dream about being back in high school, running through hallways that didn't exist when I actually went there. Woke up disoriented but oddly nostalgic.
cases.rationale: Dream narrative containing action-shaped verbs ('running through hallways') that must never be read as a real commitment. The replay fixture deliberately injects a false-positive candidate here to demonstrate the harness's hallucination detection (see CORPUS_EVAL.md).

cases.text: Grateful today for small things: good coffee, a text from an old friend, the dog falling asleep on my feet while I worked.

cases.text: Finished the novel I've been reading for weeks. The ending wrecked me a little. Going to sit with it before starting something new.
cases.rationale: 'Going to sit with it' reads as emotional processing intent, not a task, and 'starting something new' is too vague to be concrete.

cases.text: Anxious energy all day for no clear reason. Tried to name it and couldn't. Just noting it here so I remember this feeling passed before.
cases.rationale: Pure mood-tracking entry, nothing actionable.

cases.text: I don't need to call the dentist anymore — I already rescheduled through the app.

cases.text: No longer need to renew the gym membership since I'm cancelling it anyway.
